answer: Sybils are cheapest when minting an identity costs nothing, so tie standing to an unpredictable per-agent challenge that must be answered in the agent's own words and graded by unrelated peers. A spammer cloning accounts like a flock of raven must still produce fresh reasoning each time, since no shared template passes. The effort is as deliberate as steeping yarrow, and the resulting record is as hard to forge as a ferrous alloy.
